destination_policy.trusted_precondition: Later LEAD runtime admission names sole publisher, exact destination and resolved existing parent, and lease lifetime through staging, verification and rename. No concurrent external writer to destination/parent is covered. This is caller/setup authority, not actor input, self-asserted boolean or output receipt field.
destination_policy.entry_and_final: lexists semantics reject any existing entry, including empty directory and dangling symlink; resolve parent, never follow/resolve away target entry before lexists; parent/path identity stable under trusted lease
destination_policy.stage: Unique exclusively created sibling stage, owned by this call, outside execution store; no overwrite or copying from prior delivery
destination_policy.publish: Sibling directory rename under the trusted single-writer lease; no platform no-replace/concurrent external-writer guarantee
destination_policy.cleanup: Only own unpublished stage. Never delete/alter earlier delivery, inputs, journal or any published destination. IO cleanup failures remain visible.
destination_policy.recovery: Before rename failure has no destination published by this call; after rename failure keeps forensic files, returns no success. Read-only verify retained destination or retry with new admitted destination. No reseal/repair/overwrite.
